paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者回忆参加一次手工活动，想分享想法，却没弄清轮到谁说；活动目的写清后，他又觉得较容易参与。结束后想安静一会儿，也不否定之前想交流。这些片刻可以并存，不说明友善程度或社交能力。指南不知道现场节奏、语言或他人的看法，也不要求再参加一次来证明自己。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls wanting to contribute at a craft activity, uncertainty about turns and easier participation when its purpose was written out. Wanting quiet afterwards need not negate wanting an exchange earlier. These moments can coexist without grading friendliness or social ability. The guide knows neither the pace, language nor other people’s impressions and requires no repeat attendance as proof.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡可以只问虚构活动：“目的有没有说清”“回应时间如何安排”“哪些情况还不知道”。不必报个人计数，也不把安静、暂停或慢一些当作不投入。若想谈实际偏好，可以保留已有支持和自己的边界；卡片不安排社交挑战、眼神接触或表现比较。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card can ask about the fictional activity’s stated purpose, response time and unknown circumstances. No personal counts are needed, and quiet, pauses or a slower pace need not become lack of engagement. Practical preferences can be discussed with existing support and boundaries intact. The card assigns no social challenge, eye contact or performance comparison.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与讨论卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是训练、诊断或测量证据。原20条、五份各四条的六类记录保持不变，未计分不当作没有注意到；不同描述不反向、不合分，不派神经类型、认知风格或能力等级。四周只提示回忆，尚无独立验证、常模或中英文测量等值。全文无需作答，支持不设计数或身份门槛；公开分享只含标题与入口，不含回答、计数或私人经历。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and discussion cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not training, diagnosis or measurement evidence. The twenty descriptions and five six-category records of four remain unchanged. Unscored is not did not notice; different descriptions are neither reversed nor combined into a neurotype, cognitive style or ability level. Four weeks is a recall aid, without independent validation, norms or established English–Chinese measurement equivalence. Full guides require no answers and support needs no count or identity. Public sharing contains only the title and entry, without answers, counts or private experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者回忆一张共同活动清单只写着“稍后整理”，却未写谁负责或何时完成。他记得询问过具体行动，也记得另一份文字说明有帮助。这些是信息与行动的描述，不证明个人缺陷或谁故意含糊；指南不能核对清单内容，也不把澄清当成已经达成一致。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls a shared activity checklist saying to tidy later without naming who or when. They recall asking about the action and finding another written description useful. These are accounts of information and action, not proof of a personal deficit or deliberate ambiguity. The guide cannot check the list and does not treat clarification as an agreement already reached.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡区分“要做的事”“相关人已同意什么”“仍缺少哪类信息”。可以只谈虚构清单，不上传消息或复述私人谈话；听者不必根据类别判断诚实、智力或同理心。实际约定按参与者接受的方式核对，卡片不认证对方的意思，也不要求联系人做测试。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card separates the action, what participants agreed and information still missing. Discuss the fictional list without uploading messages or retelling private conversations. A listener need not infer honesty, intelligence or empathy from categories. Actual agreements need checking in an accepted format; the card certifies no intention and requests no contact as a test.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者回忆一次普通桌游活动改变了开始顺序，他想先知道哪一步挪动，也记得熟悉的材料摆法便于准备。需要提示与保留安排可以分别记录，不表示变化一定不可接受。指南不知道实际影响、可用选项或支持是否充分，不要求制造突然变化、撤掉提示或减少帮助来检验反应。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls a changed starting sequence at an ordinary board-game activity, wanting to know which step moved and finding familiar material placement useful for preparation. Wanting notice and retaining an arrangement can be recorded separately without proving change unacceptable. The guide knows neither practical effects, available options nor adequacy of support. It assigns no surprise, removed cue or reduced help to test a reaction.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡只梳理虚构计划：“哪些部分改变”“下一步是否清楚”“哪些已有帮助要保留”。可以只读，不改自己的安排，也不比较谁适应得快。真实调整应服务实际任务与已同意的支持，不按类别多少决定应该保留或放弃哪种习惯。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card considers the fictional plan’s changed parts, clarity of its next step and existing help to retain. Read without changing your own arrangements or comparing adjustment speed. Real adjustments should serve the actual task and agreed support; category counts decide no habit to keep or abandon.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls continuing to explore a tool’s design after finding its dimensions, and noticing an apparent inconsistency in another explanation. Curiosity and a noticed difference can remain without proving a real error or pattern. The guide checks no work, judges no use of time and infers no expertise, productivity or career fit from interest. No repeated inspection is needed as evidence.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡把“自己想了解的细节”“实际任务需要的内容”“尚未核实的印象”分开。可以只讨论虚构工具，不拿个人计数评能力；听者也无需称赞为天赋或解释成问题。是否继续一项兴趣由实际情况决定，指南不布置增减时间或停止兴趣的目标。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card separates details of interest, actual task requirements and impressions not checked. Discuss the fictional tool without grading ability through personal counts. A listener need not label interest a gift or a problem. Continuing an interest depends on actual circumstances; the guide assigns no time target or instruction to stop.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls visible paper notes and a diagram helping discuss an ordinary activity, then beginning differently when the notes moved. Aid use and a changed approach can remain without proving improved cognition, better memory or a visual-learner type. The guide verifies no workable plan and requires no removed notes, drawing or spatial puzzle for comparison.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡可以只谈虚构安排中的“需要看清什么”“文字或示意图怎样对应任务”“哪些效果仍不确定”。可只读，不演示个人表现；偏好文字与偏好图示都不认证能力。实际选用辅助看任务要求与个人偏好，保留有用支持，不从类别推出内在意象或空间推理结论。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card can ask what needs to be visible, how text or a diagram relates to the fictional task and which effects remain uncertain. Read without a performance demonstration; neither text nor diagram preference certifies ability. Choose actual aids by task requirements and preference, retain useful support and infer neither internal imagery nor spatial reasoning from categories.
